{{Quote|Outermost we have Golan Space Defense stations. They are comparable in power to a Star Destroyer. In addition to these defense stations, there are approximately seven Victory-class Star Destroyers on station at Coruscant. There are ground-based fighter groups as well as the fighter wings stationed in and around the ships, shipyards, and orbital factories. The orbital mirror stations and low-orbit skyhooks may also have been armed.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="WG" />}}
'''Coruscant Home Fleet''' was the name of the [[Navy/Legends|defense fleet]] permanently assigned to protect the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Best known as the '''Coruscant Defense Fleet''' during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the fleet was later part of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and similarly charged with the protection of the Imperial capital world.

==Description==
[[File:CoruscantHomeFleet-VoT.png|thumb|left|220px|The Coruscant Home Fleet defends the Republic capital world during the Clone Wars]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Coruscant Home Fleet was a branch of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. It was composed of various military personnnel meant to protect the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] and other nearby areas. Each division of the Home Fleet was commanded by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TCSWE-HF" /> Jedi were free to reassemble units from the [[Corps/Legends|Corps]] and [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Armies]] into the Home Fleet if naval maneuvers were necessary.<ref name="GtGAotR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|Battle of Anaxes]], war hero [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] was promoted to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] and given command of the Coruscant Home Fleet. The assignment allowed him time to recover from his injuries before his reassignment to the [[Reconquest of the Rim]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

After the [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|fall of Humbarine]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Barrow Oicunn/Legends|Barrow Oicunn]] served in the Coruscant Home Fleet as commander of the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Mas Ramdar/Legends|Mas Ramdar]]''.<ref name="DB-Oicunn" />

During the final days of the Clone Wars, the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] of the Home Fleet that remained in-system played a vital role in the defense of Coruscant against [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="CW23">{{CW|23}}</ref> A group of smaller strike forces, the [[Home Defense Strike Force]], was hastily assembled and put in test during the battle.<ref name="TCSWE-HDSF">{{CSWECite|II|54|Home Defense Strike Force}}</ref> [[Home Fleet Strike Group Five/Legends|Home Fleet Strike Group Five]], which consisted of three [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class]] and one [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], attacked the Separatist [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].<ref name="RotS-novel" /> Eventually, the intervention of the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]], under the direct command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], turned the tide of the battle in a decisive Republic victory.<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

After the Republic was transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Coruscant Home Fleet defended the Imperial capital during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].

At the height of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] reign, then-[[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] requested to be transferred to the Coruscant Defense Fleet in order to avoid serving at [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] side, given Vader's notorious reputation for summarily executing any officer who failed him in any way.<ref name="TFU2">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|Darth Vader ''Databank'' entry}}</ref>

[[File:TIEFighterCoruscant.png|thumb|left|220px|The Coruscant Defense Fleet during the Imperial Period.]]
The Coruscant Defense Fleet, alongside several other fleets in the Imperial Navy, were ordered to arrive at Coruscant to hear [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine's [[State of the Galactic Civil War|speech]] on the progress of the war.<ref name="TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>

In the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Coruscant Defense Fleet was made of seven [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], including the [[Emperor's Will (Victory-class)|''Emperor's Will'']], the [[Imperator (Victory-class)|''Imperator'']], the [[Monarch (Star Destroyer)|''Monarch'']] and the [[Triumph (Victory-class)|''Triumph'']]. [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]] reduced this number to only two in order to facilitate a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] invasion.<ref name="WG" />

Following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]], the New Republic also created its own [[New Republic First Fleet|Coruscant Home Fleet]].<ref name="DFRSb">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>

A century later, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]] of the [[One Sith]] re-established a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] controlled [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] with the Coruscant Defense Fleet being reformed and charged with its age old task of protecting the Imperial capital. During this time, Darth Krayt himself served as the Fleet's direct [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="LECG" />
